title: Planet capture aggregate exceeds its one-hour CTest timeout under the full correctness split
body: The all-correctness split includes this Application GPU test, which runs 12 planet states twice and hashes five artifacts per state. On the shared WSL GPU, TIMEOUT 3600 expired after C7 completed, before the remaining states ran; no capture mismatch was reported. Split the state comparisons into independently scheduled CTest cases or otherwise give the full deterministic witness a viable bounded runtime.
